the app asks for a pairing command, twice with the same name

body.command: INYON_TOKEN=<laptop-token> INYON_SUMS_SHA256=<sha256:1> sh -c 'f=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL "$1/node/install.sh" -o "$f" && if [ "$( (sha256sum "$f" 2>/dev/null || shasum -a 256 "$f") | cut -c1-64)" = "$2" ]; then sh "$f" "$1"; else echo "install.sh did not match its checksum; get a new command from the hub" >&2; false; fi; s=$?; rm -f "$f"; exit $s' inyon <hub> <sha256:2>
